title: Cheap
text: Cheap. Super cheap. Poorly sewn. Very thin fabric. I wanted to protect the leather on my ottoman, but this is so ugly and ill fitting I don't know if I'll even use it until I find something else. I'm annoyed that I paid twenty bucks for this trash.
